$comment: Pinned-source declaration for act fr-pf-core (wave 1): one entry per CSS edition publication; primary text first (CSS_ED2026_06, current law). Headings follow fr_code_lettered_article ('Article L511-1'). Derived from pinned bytes; hashes recomputed on regen.

L522-2.reason: Complement familial resource ceiling by rank and number of children, CPI-indexed: benefit computation at sibling benefit-package granularity (AF series); the socle keeps the non-accumulation principle only.

L522-3.reason: Increased complement familial amount and decree-set rates: rates fixed by decree, computation at benefit-package granularity.

L523-3.reason: ASF rates in the two orphan-assimilation cases are set by the L.584-1 decree: decree-set rates, out of scope.

L541-3.reason: AEEH applicability of L.521-2 (AF series): owned by the sibling AF package.

L541-4.reason: Isolated-parent supplement for a disabled child needing third-party care: conditions set by decree, out of scope.

L541-5.reason: AEEH serviced and controlled by family-benefit bodies for the CNSA against reimbursement: organisational and financial circuit, no self-executing socle norm.

L543-2.reason: Differential allocation where resources exceed the L.543-1 ceiling by less than a set sum: computation defined by Conseil d'Etat decree, out of scope.

L543-3.reason: Allocation paid to the Caisse des depots under child-welfare placement (consignment until majority/emancipation): third-party payment channel and procedure.

L544-1.reason: AJPP daily allowance per Labour Code leave day (L.1225-62): day-counting and leave linkage at benefit-package granularity; the socle models the 310-day cap and the information duty.

L544-2.reason: Medical gravity certificate by the treating physician and favourable medical-control opinion: medical-evidence procedure (external medical channel), not an executable norm.

L544-4.reason: Maximum daily AJPP allowances per calendar month set by decree: decree-set number, out of scope.

L544-6.reason: Daily AJPP amount set by decree (SMIC-referenced, revalued 1 January): decree-set amount, out of scope.
L544-6.despite: SMIC reference is computable, but the decree amount itself is not pinned

L544-7.reason: Expense top-up above a set amount within a resource ceiling, monthly decree-set modalities: decree-set modalities and ceiling, out of scope.

L544-8.reason: AJPP personal-scope extension to listed Labour, Rural and CSS categories: out-of-scope cross-reference; the general case is modelled.

L552-1.reason: Meta-temporal rule: changes take and cease effect under the per-benefit opening and extinction rules (modelled), unless breaking continuity; the continuity assessment is case-level (payment history).
